mode: planning/evidence only; source+official normative reads; no worker execution

BASE.section: Base protocol; $ notifications/cancellation; request ordering; text sync kinds
BASE.summary: Each processed request gets a response; notifications have no response. $ notifications may be ignored by synchronous implementations; cancellation still needs a response if detected. Full sync sends complete content. Capabilities delimit support.

INIT.summary: Before initialize requests get -32002 and notifications except exit drop. Initialize only once; client sends nothing further until response. Required processId/rootUri/capabilities. Non-null parent process disappearing should cause exit.

INITIALIZED.summary: Client sends initialized once after initialize response and before other traffic. Server may use it for registration.

OPEN.summary: Client owns opened text; server must not read it via URI. Duplicate unbalanced opens violate client obligation; close/open changes language ownership.

CHANGE.summary: Change requires prior open. Content changes apply in arrival/array order; version refers to resulting state. Full event carries text without range.

VERSION.summary: Client change version increases including undo/redo, need not be consecutive. No normative server stale-version rejection mechanism specified here.

CLOSE.summary: Ownership returns away from client when closed; open/close balanced. Supported server features are not intrinsically restricted to opened documents by the protocol.

DIAGNOSTICS.summary: Server owns clearing diagnostics. VS Code single-file rule clears on close; project servers may retain/recompute. Changed empty result must push empty array; newly pushed result replaces prior result. Version support is a client capability.

SHUTDOWN.summary: Shutdown replies null without exiting. Client sends no further messages except exit; requests after shutdown error InvalidRequest.

EXIT.summary: Exit chooses 0 when shutdown was previously received, otherwise 1.

REFERENCES.summary: referencesProvider supports project-wide symbol references; ReferenceContext.includeDeclaration controls declaration inclusion.

WORKSPACE_EDIT.summary: Clients lacking both documentChanges and resourceOperations support only plain TextEdits in changes. Versioned carrier support is a client capability.

caller_closure: read_message -> strict json parse -> parse_call -> handle_json -> known method valid_params
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Unique legal request correlation, duplicate reserved keys rejected; required consumed schemas validated. Malformed method notifications silently leave lifecycle/docs unchanged; envelope errors can emit InvalidRequest with safe ID/null.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Before-init malformed sync and bad version/range/change arrays preserve docs/pending; requests get typed protocol errors, legal notifications no response.
finite_duties.limits: Preserved Step4 admission scope. Nonreserved extension fields accepted/ignored; no full arbitrary client-capability schema validation. No fresh worker execution.

finite_duties.duty: Initialize state transition and advertised scope
caller_closure: Server new PreInit -> initialize request -> Ready capabilities -> initialized no-op
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Single valid initialize moves directly Ready; repeat initialize errors. UTF16, Full sync, hover/completion/definition/references/rename/full semanticTokens/codeAction advertised. rootUri/workspaceFolders/client schemas not stored; initialized does no registration. processId is validated but not stored or monitored; a non-null parent disappearing cannot itself trigger exit.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Preinit requests -32002; valid initialize response then initialized, document operations; repeat init -32600. No advertised workspaceFolders/project symbol/dynamic registration/pull diagnostics/incremental sync.
finite_duties.limits: initialized ordering is client precondition; server accepting data before initialized is not independently shown protocol violation. Current custom client sends processId/rootUri null. Official parent-exit guidance uses should; the bundled client uses null. Root process review owns any orphan-parent witness.

finite_duties.duty: Open client-owned buffer and source identity
caller_closure: didOpen -> docs URI key -> reused live id if same text else SourceDb add -> pending(uri,version)
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Accepts any validated languageId string; URI exact protocol key, display path separately projected. Open text supplied by client, no URI filesystem reads. Identical duplicate opens share SourceId; new text appends.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Balanced open/close normal sequence; duplicate open probe classified invalid-client robustness. Opaque URI open/query remains same identity.
finite_duties.limits: Does not check extension/languageId equals can; likely future filtering choice, not automatic defect. Duplicate opens overwrite current version/text rather than reject; client must balance them.

finite_duties.duty: Full-text edits and actual change-array selection
caller_closure: didChange validation -> existing docs selector -> last event without range -> id reuse/new add -> pending
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Only events with no range replace whole text; last full event wins. Range-only incremental edits ignored with no version advance; mixed array applies final full event and discards range edits. Empty array leaves state unchanged.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Two full replacement events yield last text; only ranged event preserves prior buffer/version (unsupported mode); invalid range shape rejects whole notification before mutation.
finite_duties.limits: FULL advertised; a client sending ranged incremental edits violates selected mode. Do not label ignored incremental edits as supported-feature defect. Mixed event sequencing not implemented generally; no new policy selection.

caller_closure: OpenDoc version -> change -> reuse live SourceId for equal text but replace version and enqueue
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Any admitted i32 version overwrites current, including same/decreasing/negative versions; no monotonic guard. Equal-content versions reuse current SourceId and still enqueue/publish.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Increasing versions with gaps and equal text yield latest version publication; same/decreasing edits probe robustness and show replacement, not normative rejection obligation.
finite_duties.limits: Client must increase version; illegal repeated/decreasing versions are not valid-client protocol correctness witnesses. Finite i32 bound from input contract; no generation/epoch number apart from version.

finite_duties.duty: Queued task identity and stale filtering
caller_closure: handle_json sync enqueues -> pump drains VecDeque -> docs.get(uri) version equality -> diagnostics
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Queue entries contain only URI/version; superseded different version or absent doc skips. No actual background task/future/thread; pump calls backend synchronously. Same-version queued entries each recompute latest text.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Public batch open v1/change v2/change v3 before pump publishes only v3; close before pump skips all. Public close/reopen same URI + version before pump invokes new buffer twice (old epoch entry resurrected).
inspected_regressions: compiler/tests/ide.rs:755–769 (real backend, public batch v1/v2 before pump; recipe inspected only)
finite_duties.limits: Epoch/repeated-version bug lead is duplicate current work/public promised stale cancellation gap, not publication of old bytes; production pumps each message and normally cannot create such batch. pending_count is only queue introspection, not active async work count.

finite_duties.duty: Real diagnostic analysis and result currentness
caller_closure: pump docs id/text -> RealAnalysis snapshot -> check_program diagnostics+catalog errors+lint -> span_to_range -> versioned publish
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Current SourceId used for snapshot; errors and lint merge even mid-edit; catalog failures reanchor to doc start; current file diagnostics filtered, sorted and published with version. Empty result sent on valid open/change.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Invalid source open emits errors; repaired increasing change emits empty/current diagnostic set, replacing old. Distinct URI version routing and UTF16 span consistency.
inspected_regressions: compiler/tests/ide.rs:732–751 (real backend publish E3002; recipe inspected only)
finite_duties.limits: Emitter carries coherent diagnostics supplied by backend; external trait implementors can hand wrong file spans. Client filtering/version use is another owner; no source-map/runtime correctness inference.

caller_closure: didClose -> docs remove; later pump absent doc skip; custom client diagnostics.delete separately
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Server sends no empty publish on close and no explicit close response; pending queue is not pruned immediately. Custom client clears diagnostic collection locally.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Valid malformed open/nonempty publication -> close -> request barrier: server should emit empty clear under single-file VS Code diagnostic rule; actual source predicts no clear. Bundled editor may show correct UI due local delete.
inspected_regressions: lsp_typed_output.rs current coverage has no close-clear assertion; existing lifecycle unit tests
finite_duties.limits: Probable server diagnostic lifecycle gap requiring root fresh transcript. Protocol quote is stated VS Code single-file guidance; do not claim bundled visible stale diagnostics already witnessed. Closing drops live docs not historical SourceDb bytes.

finite_duties.duty: Synchronous request query state and reply ordering
caller_closure: request -> docs current id -> RealAnalysis trait method -> fresh Snapshot analyze -> typed output
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Each supported data request reads current synchronized open doc and returns before later input read; no persistent Snapshot/query cache. Unknown docs usually InvalidParams; rename returns null. references context includeDeclaration validated but not passed to backend.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Open/change/request barriers query latest text; known URI after close has controlled error/null outcomes. Rename edit version equals current live document; query locations remain single-file.
inspected_regressions: lsp_typed_output.rs:311–541; ide.rs query tests read previously in Step5/Step10
finite_duties.limits: No asynchronous stale request machinery. Supported includeDeclaration false is now independently witnessed to return declaration in root server-options receipts; no disk project query for closed files. Actual GUI interpretation is separate.

caller_closure: fresh snapshot -> hash-filter lint fix -> byte ranges -> current version -> WorkspaceEdit
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Rename current file edits carry live version; lint actions filter source id/hash/range then package by URI with known live versions (unknown cross-doc version null). Server offers edits, does not apply source mutations.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Increasing edit changes queried action/rename byte/UTF16 ranges and version; fake backend multiURI groups keep URI and known/null versions.
finite_duties.limits: Root server-options witnesses rename documentChanges even when corresponding client capability is absent: carrier negotiation defect, separate from client wire-version application. No GUI edit application or server mutation atomicity proof; lint-action carrier shares emitter but was not independently probed here.

caller_closure: request synchronous handle -> write response -> pump -> next read; cancel notification ignored
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Valid $/cancelRequest no-op; no request map/active task token and no RequestCancelled emission. Stale notification diagnostics queue skip is unrelated request cancellation.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Slow fake backend request followed by cancel still completes response; cancellation arriving after synchronous completion harmless; valid notification silent.
inspected_regressions: server.rs lifecycle tests and lsp_admission notification admission; no fresh slow callback probe
finite_duties.limits: Spec explicitly allows ignoring $ notifications for synchronous implementations. Responsiveness/latency limitation is distinct from protocol defect; no claimed interruptible analysis or async queue execution.

caller_closure: Ready shutdown -> Shutdown null response; later requests InvalidRequest; exit -> exited/code -> run loop stop
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Postshutdown ordinary notifications dropped, all requests except special initialize reject. Valid exit code 0 after shutdown,1 otherwise; no source cleanup needed at process exit. Public handle_json can still be called after exited flag; pump lacks lifecycle guard.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Valid initialize/shutdown/exit0; direct exit1; repeatshutdown/postshutdown request errors. Public queued-open -> shutdown -> pump may still publish; inventory boundary not a proven normative requirement.
finite_duties.limits: Production pump after each sync leaves no pending task by subsequent shutdown normally. EOF without exit uses default selected code rather than normative exit notification logic. Signal handling separate root process review.

finite_duties.duty: Framed stdio disconnect and malformed frame recovery
caller_closure: blocking read -> UTF8/JSON parse -> response/pump write; EOF/UnexpectedEof flush best effort
finite_duties.actual_supported_behavior: Clean/torn EOF ends session with selected code; broken output ends loop. Framing InvalidData continues reading using same server state; parsing invalid UTF8/JSON emits ParseError.64MiB body cap but no total header cap or reader timeout.
finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: Clean/torn EOF terminates finite process; malformed frame may fail resynchronization. Root must bound hanging client/longbody/header streams and distinguish memory/time/protocol outcome.
inspected_regressions: lsp_admission.rs transcript helper98 onward; transport unit tests
finite_duties.limits: No claim connection state actually resets despite source comment. Resource/header policy gaps and OS signals owned root; stable std no signal handler. Body cap does not limit retained sources or total session traffic.

inspected_regressions: catalog loader integration tests navigation; actual client.ts545–563 null root

However referencesProvider is advertised and official references are project-wide: absent workspace capabilities do not erase that broader promise. finite_duties.duty: Fresh per-request analysis and history-scaled lint work
caller_closure: Every RealAnalysis query creates a Snapshot; diagnostics/actions call lint run_with_files, parsing and running lint rules over every retained SourceDb revision with the current CheckedProgram.

finite_duties.independent_expected_witness: N distinct text revisions retain N entries; diagnostic at revision N traverses N lint sources; equal-content live change no new source. Timing/RSS cannot substitute for direct traversal source proof.
